jei.witchery.heat_kettle: Heat one bucket of water from below.
jei.witchery.jar: Consumed if the oven collects a fume.
guide.witchery.no_biomes: No suitable biomes are available in this world.
guide.witchery.day_only: Cast during the day to bring on midnight.
guide.witchery.bind_waystone: Binds a Waystone to this Heart Glyph’s location.
guide.witchery.copy_waystone: Makes two Waystones with the original destination and custom name.
guide.witchery.bind_circle_talisman: Stores complete chalk rings in a blank Circle Talisman. Use the bound talisman on solid ground to place the rings again.
guide.witchery.storm_waystone: Offer a location-bound Waystone to call the lightning at its bound position.
guide.witchery.protection_effect.impriso: Pulls creatures back from the edge.
guide.witchery.protection_effect.barrier: Blocks creatures. Players can pass through.
guide.witchery.protection_effect.portabl: Blocks creatures and players for one minute.
guide.witchery.barrier_waystone: A Bound Waystone sets the barrier’s location.
guide.witchery.broken_earth_heading: Drop the brew to the side of the heart to direct the fissure.
guide.witchery.moving_earth_waystone: A Bound Waystone sets the center of the rising column.
guide.witchery.recipe.rite_of_summoning_: Rite of Summoning a Spectral Familiar
guide.witchery.summoning_clearance: Leave the space above the Heart Glyph clear.
guide.witchery.demon_banishment: Banishes Demons, Death, the Lord of Torment, Imps, and Reflections within nine blocks.
guide.witchery.spectral_familiar_search: Give the spectral familiar a diamond to have it search for ore.
guide.witchery.fertility_effect: A widening wave grows plants, clears nausea, blindness, and poison, and cures zombie villagers. An active cat familiar strengthens the wave.
guide.witchery.natures_power_effect: Turns nearby stone, sand, gravel, and mycelium into patches of grass and water, and grows trees and wild plants.
guide.witchery.call_beasts_effect: Summon at least three coven witches with a Seer Stone. Nearby animals are drawn to the circle in pairs.
guide.witchery.recipe.rite_of_rain_of_to: Rite of the Rain of Toads
guide.witchery.blight_effect: A widening wave spoils crops, sickens players, and harms or transforms farm animals and villagers.
guide.witchery.area_blindness_effect: A widening wave blinds players and creatures. An active cat familiar extends the blindness.
guide.witchery.hell_on_earth_effect: Cast in the Overworld. A Bound Waystone can direct the expanding wave of netherrack to another location.
guide.witchery.hell_on_earth_upkeep: Once the wave is fully grown, it draws 200 power from an altar near the target every two seconds to summon a Nether creature.
guide.witchery.toad_rain_effect: Summon a coven witch with a Seer Stone. Lightning brings rain and a shower of short-lived poisonous toads.
guide.witchery.prior_incarnation_effect: Cast within 16 blocks of a death. Players within five blocks of the glyph can recover their items once the drops despawn while they are online.
guide.witchery.volcano_lava: Requires a lava reservoir below the target.
guide.witchery.volcano_waystone: A Bound Waystone can direct the eruption to another location.
guide.witchery.cooking_effect: Drop raw food within five blocks of the Heart Glyph to cook it.
guide.witchery.cooking_burn_chance: %s%% of the food may burn into charcoal.
guide.witchery.directed_curse.misfortune: Plagues the target with recurring ailments. Strong curses can make the target drop a held item.
guide.witchery.directed_curse.insanity: Makes the target see creatures other players cannot see.
guide.witchery.directed_curse.sinking: Makes the target sink faster in water and descend during magical flight.
guide.witchery.directed_curse.overheatin: Sets the target on fire in hot, dry biomes.
guide.witchery.directed_curse.waking_nig: A Nightmare stalks the target while awake.
guide.witchery.directed_cure: A stronger cure is more likely to succeed. An active cat familiar and a summoned coven can strengthen it.
guide.witchery.missing_ingredient: No loaded item matches this offering.
guide.witchery.atlas_copy: Craft with paper to copy this biome onto a note. The atlas is returned.
guide.witchery.book_collecting_fumes.int: A Witch’s Oven cooks food, turns logs into charcoal, and burns saplings into Wood Ash. Put fuel below the input and empty Clay Jars beside the fume output.
guide.witchery.book_collecting_fumes.jar: Fire Soft Clay Jars before using them. Keep an empty jar in the oven when a batch finishes. A Fume Funnel beside the oven speeds the work and improves the chance of catching a fume.
guide.witchery.book_collecting_fumes.sap: Oak gives Exhale of the Horned One. Birch gives Breath of the Goddess. Spruce gives Hint of Rebirth. Rowan gives Whiff of Magic, alder gives Reek of Misfortune, and hawthorn gives Odour of Purity. Acacia and dark oak give ash.
guide.witchery.book_distilling.intro: Set a Distillery within reach of a formed altar. Supply the two ingredients in either order and add enough empty Clay Jars. A batch pauses while altar power is unavailable.
guide.witchery.book_circle_magic.intro: Draw the rings around a Heart Glyph. For rites that spend energy, place an altar within reach. Drop the listed offerings or place them in Grasspers. Use the Heart Glyph to start. Hold a Seer Stone when you want to call your coven. Each diagram shows the pattern from above.
Fill a Kettle with water and light a fire beneath it. Drop in the listed ingredients in any order. Keep a powered altar within reach for costly brews and collect the result with empty glass bottles.
guide.witchery.book_herbology.intro: A witch’s garden supplies brewing ingredients, ritual offerings, and living tools. Each entry gives the plant’s use and shows its mature form.
guide.witchery.book_of_biomes.intro: The Rite of Climate Change uses a large white circle and at least four coven witches. Drop a focus near the heart. The number beside each biome is how much Glowstone Dust selects it.
guide.witchery.book_symbology.intro: An infused witch can hold Use on a Mystic Branch and draw the strokes with their gaze. Release Use to cast the recognised shape. Stronger gestures require Worship. Learned spells appear in this guide.
guide.witchery.book_conjuration_and_feti: Load a Brazier and light it with Flint and Steel. A powered altar supports most recipes. Shown ingredients go into the three slots in any order.
Trap a wandering spirit or spectral undead in a Spectral Stone. Use the Rite of Binding with an unbound fetish and the listed spirits. The placed fetish can use taglocks to choose whom to watch.
guide.witchery.cauldronbook.intro: Fill a Witch’s Cauldron with three water buckets and heat it from below. Drop one ingredient at a time. Add capacity before effects. An altar supplies the power required to bottle the mixture.
guide.witchery.cauldronbook.delivery: Use Gunpowder or a Globe Artichoke for a splash, Bat Wool for gas, Wormwood for liquid, or a Zombie Head for a triggered brew. Range and lifetime modifiers work on suitable deliveries.
guide.witchery.cauldronbook.rituals: White and infernal chalk around a boiling cauldron shape ritual costs. Recipes with a final offering must receive it last. The following pages list the currently available rites and ingredients.
guide.witchery.plant.belladonna.title: Belladonna
guide.witchery.plant.belladonna: Grow the seed on farmland. The flowers go into ritual offerings and extend the lifetime of some cauldron brews.
guide.witchery.plant.embermoss.title: Ember Moss
guide.witchery.plant.embermoss: Use Mutandis to find Ember Moss. It spreads on suitable soil and sand, sets creatures alight on contact, and must be gathered with shears.
guide.witchery.plant.glintweed.title: Glint Weed
guide.witchery.plant.glintweed: A luminous plant grown through mutation. It spreads where there is a suitable surface and lights the surrounding area.
guide.witchery.plant.mandrake.title: Mandrake
guide.witchery.plant.mandrake: Grow the seeds on farmland. Mature roots go into Mutandis and cauldron brews. Take care when harvesting a living Mandrake.
guide.witchery.plant.snowbell.title: Snowbell
guide.witchery.plant.snowbell: Grow this cold-weather ingredient on farmland. Mature plants produce Snowballs and Icy Needles.
guide.witchery.plant.spanishmoss.title: Spanish Moss
guide.witchery.plant.spanishmoss: Grow Spanish Moss on a wall or below a solid block, then harvest it with shears. It is used to make Poppets, the Brew of Flowing Spirit, and Leech Chests.
guide.witchery.plant.wild_bramble.title: Wild Bramble
guide.witchery.plant.wild_bramble: Mutate a cactus surrounded by Spanish Moss and filled Grasspers. The bramble is a living obstacle and an ingredient for the infused brew base.
guide.witchery.plant.ender_bramble.title: Ender Bramble
guide.witchery.plant.ender_bramble: Mutate sugar cane with Spanish Moss and four Grasspers containing Ender Pearls. The thicket is associated with Otherwhere.
guide.witchery.plant.voidbramble.title: Void Bramble
guide.witchery.plant.voidbramble: Void Bramble teleports creatures that brush against it. Circle rites cannot start within 32 blocks of a bramble.
guide.witchery.plant.artichoke.title: Water Artichoke
guide.witchery.plant.artichoke: Plant the seeds in shallow water on suitable ground. The mature crop produces Globe Artichokes, which turn cauldron brews into splashes.
guide.witchery.plant.treefyd.title: Treefyd
guide.witchery.plant.treefyd: Plant a Treefyd Seed on soil to grow a guardian. Give it a Taglock to spare the subject, or sneak-use to forget it. A Boline toggles patrol. A Creeper Heart or Demon Heart strengthens it. Use another seed on the guardian to share its training with a new Treefyd.
guide.witchery.plant.grassper.title: Grassper
guide.witchery.plant.grassper: Use a Mutating Sprig to create this living holder. It accepts a single stack, and nearby circle rites can take their offerings directly from it.
guide.witchery.plant.crittersnare.title: Critter Snare
guide.witchery.plant.crittersnare: Mutate an appropriate plant with a Mutating Sprig. The snare captures small creatures such as bats, providing Bat Wool.
guide.witchery.plant.bloodrose.title: Blood Rose
guide.witchery.plant.bloodrose: Make this flowering mutation with a Mutating Sprig. Vampires can use a harvested Blood Rose as part of their blood supply.
guide.witchery.plant.somniancotton.title: Somnian Cotton
guide.witchery.plant.somniancotton: Gather cotton in the Spirit World. It supplies fancy thread, helps mutate wheat into Wormwood, and extends some brew dispersals.
guide.witchery.plant.wolfsbane.title: Wolfsbane
guide.witchery.plant.wolfsbane: Grow and harvest the crop for the Wolfsbane effect. It is used to identify and weaken werewolves.
guide.witchery.plant.garlic.title: Garlic
guide.witchery.plant.garlic: Grow cloves on farmland. Garlic is used for vampire protection, including the Garlic Garland.
guide.witchery.plant.alder.title: Alder
guide.witchery.plant.alder: Obtain the sapling with Mutandis. Smelting it in a Witch’s Oven can yield Reek of Misfortune.
guide.witchery.plant.hawthorn.title: Hawthorn
guide.witchery.plant.hawthorn: Obtain the sapling with Mutandis. Smelting it in a Witch’s Oven can yield Odour of Purity.
guide.witchery.plant.rowan.title: Rowan
guide.witchery.plant.rowan: Obtain the sapling with Mutandis. Rowan logs form part of the altar, and its saplings produce Whiff of Magic in an oven.
guide.witchery.brazier.spectre.title: Conjure a Spectre
guide.witchery.brazier.spectre: A Spectre appears when the ingredients finish burning.
guide.witchery.brazier.banshee.title: Conjure a Banshee
guide.witchery.brazier.banshee: A Banshee appears at the end of the burn.
guide.witchery.brazier.mist.title: Mist
guide.witchery.brazier.mist: A cloud of smoke spreads around the Brazier.
guide.witchery.brazier.strength.title: Strength
guide.witchery.brazier.strength: Creatures near the brazier periodically gain Strength.
guide.witchery.brazier.resistance.title: Resistance
guide.witchery.brazier.resistance: Creatures near the brazier periodically gain Resistance.
guide.witchery.brazier.invisibility: Creatures near the brazier periodically become invisible.
guide.witchery.brazier.wilting.title: Wilting
guide.witchery.brazier.wilting: The burn stunts nearby crops and can heal vampires and undead.
guide.witchery.fetish.enhanced_poppets: A bound fetish improves the protection of compatible poppets near its owner.
guide.witchery.fetish.sentinel.title: Sentinel
guide.witchery.fetish.sentinel: The fetish summons spectral defenders against intruders.
guide.witchery.fetish.screamer.title: Screamer
guide.witchery.fetish.screamer: The fetish raises an alarm when it detects an intruder.
guide.witchery.fetish.twister.title: Twister
guide.witchery.fetish.twister: An intruder looking toward the fetish is turned away. Hostile creatures can also be diverted.
guide.witchery.fetish.ghost_walker.title: Ghost Walker
guide.witchery.fetish.ghost_walker: A spirit walker who stays near the fetish can maintain a physical presence longer.
guide.witchery.symbol.ignianima: Ignites Soulfire where the projectile lands.
guide.witchery.symbol.morsmordre: Places a Dark Mark at impact.
guide.witchery.symbol.tormentum: Sends a creature or player to Torment.
guide.witchery.symbol.confundus: Hinders the target’s ability to fight.
guide.witchery.symbol.leonard_1: Casts from the first saved slot of Leonard’s Urn.
guide.witchery.symbol.leonard_2: Casts from the second saved slot of Leonard’s Urn.
guide.witchery.symbol.leonard_3: Casts from the third saved slot of Leonard’s Urn.
guide.witchery.symbol.leonard_4: Casts from the fourth saved slot of Leonard’s Urn.
guide.witchery.symbol.attraho: Pulls nearby creatures toward the caster.
guide.witchery.symbol.accio: Teleports dropped items near the impact back to the caster. Enhanced gestures increase the reach.
guide.witchery.symbol.alohomora: Opens or closes the door the spell hits. It can operate a Rowan door without a key.
guide.witchery.symbol.cave_inimicum: Reinforces earth, planks, sand, clay, and masonry. It can turn an oak door into an iron door.
guide.witchery.symbol.colloportus: Turns the struck door into a closed Rowan door. Casting the spell grants no key.
guide.witchery.symbol.defodio: Excavates eligible stone, soil, sand, clay, and ice from the struck face. Enhanced gestures excavate a wider square.
guide.witchery.symbol.crucio: Damages the creature or player it strikes. Requires the Infernal Infusion.
guide.witchery.symbol.ennervate: Removes Slowness, Mining Fatigue and Nausea. Enhanced gestures affect creatures and players near the impact.
guide.witchery.symbol.episkey: Spends hunger to heal wounds. Enhanced gestures also heal creatures and players near the caster.
guide.witchery.symbol.imperio: Binds an eligible creature to obey the caster. Requires the Infernal Infusion.
guide.witchery.symbol.protego: Raises a temporary barrier wall at the targeted block.
guide.witchery.symbol.stupefy: Stuns the target for five minutes if it is free of Slowness.
guide.witchery.symbol.aguamenti: Conjures water or fills a brewing vessel. Enhanced gestures spread water, and the strongest can conjure it in the Nether.
guide.witchery.symbol.incendio: Lights a fire, a filled brazier, or a bloodied Wicker Man. Enhanced gestures spread fire on the ground and ignite nearby creatures.
guide.witchery.symbol.lumos: Places a floating Glow Globe against the struck surface.
guide.witchery.symbol.nox: Breaks unprotected light sources within ten blocks in each direction.
guide.witchery.cauldron.modifier.capacit: Adds %s capacity below a capacity of %s.
guide.witchery.cauldron.modifier.strengt: Raises the strength of the next effect.
guide.witchery.cauldron.modifier.duratio: Extends the duration of the next effect.
guide.witchery.cauldron.modifier.invert: Inverts the next effect when an alternate effect exists.
guide.witchery.cauldron.modifier.hide_pa: Conceals particles for the next effect.
guide.witchery.cauldron.modifier.extent: Increases the range of applicable delivery.
guide.witchery.cauldron.modifier.lifetim: Increases the lifetime of applicable delivery.
guide.witchery.cauldron.modifier.wayston: A bound Waystone provides a destination for spells that accept one.
guide.witchery.cauldron.modifier.no_bloc: Prevents later effects from targeting blocks.
guide.witchery.cauldron.modifier.no_enti: Prevents later effects from targeting creatures.
guide.witchery.cauldron.modifier.raise_e: Raises the strength limit of later effects.
guide.witchery.cauldron.modifier.set_col: Sets the color of the brew.
guide.witchery.cauldron.delivery.gas: The thrown brew spreads as a gas.
guide.witchery.cauldron.delivery.liquid: The thrown brew spreads as a liquid.
guide.witchery.cauldron.delivery.trigger: The thrown brew curses compatible switches, pressure plates, or doors.

Rite Of Binding A Creature Waystone Portable

message.witchery.goddess.overheating: The Goddess lifts your curse of overheating.
message.witchery.goddess.waking_nightmar: The Goddess frees you from the waking nightmare.

item.witchery.canesword.siphon: Siphons blood from kills. Use while sheathed to drink.
item.witchery.earmuffs.tip: Mutes sound and protects against Mandrake and Banshee screams while worn.

message.witchery.glassgoblet.follow_elle: Elle has answered the ritual. Follow her to a pool of lava.
message.witchery.glassgoblet.elle_warnin: Elle waits over the lava. She is beginning to change.

message.witchery.glassgoblet.lilith_offe: Lilith awaits a goblet or a gift.

message.witchery.glassgoblet.lilith_ench: Lilith returns your offering with an enchantment.

message.witchery.glassgoblet.blood_low: You do not have enough blood to fill the goblet.
message.witchery.glassgoblet.not_drained: Drain the villager's blood before making the offering.

item.witchery.mirror.bridge: The mirror has become a gateway.

message.witchery.mirror.you: You are the fairest of them all.

message.witchery.mirror.another_female: There is a woman fairer than you.
message.witchery.mirror.players_not_seen: I have seen no other visitors.

message.witchery.wolfaltar.gold_offered: The Moon Charm gives you control of the wolf.
message.witchery.wolfaltar.charm_replace: The Huntsman has granted another Moon Charm.

message.witchery.wolfaltar.final_hunt_fi: You have mastered the Curse of the Wolf.

item.witchery.bound_poppet.unbound: Unbound. Craft this with a filled Taglock Kit.

message.witchery.rite.requires_full_cove: Use a Seer Stone to call a full coven of six witches for this rite.
message.witchery.rite.cure_vampirism.no_: The Taglock must belong to a living vampire player.
message.witchery.rite.cure_vampirism.too: The vampire must be within eight blocks of the ritual circle.
message.witchery.rite.storm_only: This rite can only be started during a thunderstorm.
message.witchery.rite.directed_curse_dre: Taglock curses and cures cannot take hold in the Spirit World.

book.witchery.immortal.toc: Notes on the blood rites and the strange powers they awaken.
book.witchery.immortal.ritual1: The rite begins with a skeleton skull beneath the open sky. Lay a ring of string around it. Place four torches at the sides and make short lines of redstone at the corners.
book.witchery.immortal.ritual2: Keep an empty Glass Goblet in your hotbar. Kill a chicken on the skull with a Boline. The goblet will catch its blood if the offerings are in place.
book.witchery.immortal.ritual3: The skull stands at the center. Set the torches inside the string ring.
book.witchery.immortal.ritual4: At night, pour the chicken's blood over the skull. A follower will appear. Bring her to the middle of a broad, open pool of lava and wait for Lilith.
book.witchery.immortal.ritual5: Prove yourself to Lilith in battle and offer her the empty goblet. Drink what she returns while sheltered from the sun. A coffin offers shelter in the daytime.
book.witchery.immortal.transfix: Scroll beyond the first hotbar slot to select your fangs. Get close and drink until your blood reserve is full. The eye will then let you still a victim or grant sight in the dark when used while crouching.
book.witchery.immortal.knockback: Take six careful sips that leave a villager with around half its blood. A sip taken too far will undo your progress. Once this trial is complete, crouch and strike to send an enemy flying.
book.witchery.immortal.speed: Spend ten minutes through the dark hours after mastering the careful sip. The next power quickens your steps and leaps. Use it again to strengthen a burst already underway.
book.witchery.immortal.resistsun: Trap the sun's light and stand within ten bursts of it. The trial teaches you to stand in sunlight for as long as your blood reserve holds.
book.witchery.immortal.smashstone: Defeat twenty Blazes in close combat. Afterward, crouch and strike ordinary stone without a pickaxe to shatter it. The effort costs hunger.
book.witchery.immortal.bats: Call on Lilith again. Give her a poppy, the color of fresh blood. She will teach you to take wing and spend your blood to stay aloft.
book.witchery.immortal.mesmerize: Explore four different villages after learning to fly. Your gaze will grow strong enough to lead a villager wherever you go.
book.witchery.immortal.maker: Lead villagers into iron cages with solid roofs. Seal the opening and use your gaze before tending to their blood.
book.witchery.immortal.maker2: Complete six careful sips from captive villagers. Leave each victim with around half its blood.
book.witchery.immortal.finalpowers: Capture your own blood in a goblet. Near a coffin, offer it to a mesmerized villager drained of blood. Turning a new vampire completes the final trial.
